items.description: Driving Evals collects, stores and communicates student and instructor evaluations for High Performance Driving Events. It pulls and pushes student/instructor data from MotorsportReg.com.
A new developing comparison shopping mashup using Shopping.com API.
Twyric is the art of mashing up Twitter poems with Flickr images for contemplation. Twyric = Twitter + lyric.
Watch music videos of songs you listen to on Last.fm. Also, watch what your Last.fm friends are listening to. Main feature is the music wizard.

MeetWays lets you find a point of interest between two given addresses. For example, to meet a friend for lunch you can enter his and your addresses, type of restaurant and get the exact halfway point and a list of nearby restaurants.

A promo site for Penguin books, tracking the tour of a woolly mammoth across the UK. Vistors are invited to share their photos of the mammoth via Flickr, and post opinions. Photos are referenced by city, opinions by postcode and presented via GoogleMaps.

To assist users when making Uber requests, SurgeProtector lets one know if the area they are in is currently experiencing peek pricing. This is filterable buy specific Uber model. If there is no surge, users can request a ride from within the app.

Instagr.in is a web-based version of Instagram that supplies to users the complete functionality of Instagram, including browsing user feeds, tagging users & locations, liking/unliking, performing a search of Instagram by keyword or username, commenting, as well as downloading and sharing photos. In addition to these normal functions, a unique aspect of Instagr.in is that the blend tab will aggregate occurrences of identical of users, hashtags, and locations into a single feed.
This quiz challenges users to guess what city you are looking at, while only seeing the location of starbucks branches in that city. Yes, it is as hard as it seems.
Penny Parrot is an Amazon price trackef of products on Amazon. Its modern and mobile-friendly charts let you see the exact price at any moment. You can subscribe for price drop alerts via email.
Online bed and breakfast directory with listings worldwide, travel gift certificates and Blog.
Provides tracking information of Australia Post parcels, with visualized parcel locations on Google Maps.
Tthis is a resources for expats looking for work outside of America.
Malta hotels with integrated map of YouTube videos.
DVDCrate: The online DVD cataloger and organizer. Track your viewings, share with friends, keep with with disc loans, manage your collection. Much more!
Plant and gardening maps featuring an interactive USDA zone hardiness map.

Fongo provides a free phone call and SMS platform to residents of Canada by leveraging inexpensive WiFi/4G/3G data networks. Much of the information needed to make this a free service comes from the Yellow API data.

No more raffle tickets or business cards in a hat. Attendees enter using their mobile phone and you randomly pick a winner. No download required. Works on iPhone, Android, Blackberry, Windows 7 phones and others.

Mapinterest links Pinterest, Instagram and YouTube with Facebook Places. You follow people on Twitter, on Facebook you follow your friends, on Pinterest you follow topics and on Mapinterest you follow places.
Sophisticated home valuation tools. 65 million listings. Extensive data on comprables, many search and sort options.
Find babysitters, nannies, and other care options visually with Google Maps.
A concept that can be summed up by the equation: map plus timeline equals resume. Create yours. It Uses the MIT Simile Timeline JavaScript component.
PervWatch.org makes it easy for anyone to quickly find sex offenders in a graphical way. (Data availability varies by state.)
Digital marketplace using modified BitTorrent network for distribution. Allows sellers to list their items, and Buyers to get paid for helping distribute.
Twitmart is a free classifieds marketplace using Twitter.
GoOffCampus.com is a resource intended to help students find rental properties close to campuses all over the US.
Up to 2 Gb to share geolocated photos.
StumblePics allows you to discover new pictures by stumbling upon them.

DocuSign for Microsoft is an eSignature application that is integrated with Microsoft Word. The application lets users to review and send documents for signature directly from the MS Office applications that they are using. The recipients are then able to sign the documents electronically using DocuSign.
Uses vk.com (vkontakte.ru), soundcloud.com, ex.fm, last.fm and youtube.com to give you music player and social app.
